description: This walk takes you from Hawes to Snaizeholme and the lovely red squirrel trail. Starting in the town you can follow trails south west to the site where you can pick up the peaceful woodland trails and look out for the squirrels. It's just over a 4 mile walk to the viewing area from Hawes. Other wildlife you may see include roe deer and birds such as siskin, lesser redpoll and maybe even a common crossbill. You can also explore the Snaizeholme valley further and enjoy views of the pretty Snaizeholme Beck and the surrounding Yorkshire Dales countryside.
